column7: ATOMIC-OWED-1 leftover (REVOKE-LEFTOVERS-1 item 2): SetProjectMemberRole removed the member's project roles and then granted the new one with no compensation, so an AssignRole STORAGE error after the removal could leave the project with no administrator. Fixed by #3488 (role_set_replace.go: the sole-admin swap is one fail-closed transaction, swapUserRoleSet; otherwise the removal commits only while another administrator remains and a failed grant is a PartialMutationError). mixed-request-split-005 proves it with the grant's audit row refused; this test faults tx.AssignRole itself and reads the database (SQLite always, PostgreSQL pg-gated). Red on 7e670da83 (sole-admin swap: role set [] instead of [project_admin]; co-admin demotion: not reported as partial), green on main 3ad4c30db.
